lessons.title: The Company That Will Change
lessons.context: A short story using the future tense about organizational change.

paragraphs.fr: Le directeur a annoncé que l'entreprise changerait de stratégie l'année prochaine.
paragraphs.en: The director announced that the company will change strategy next year.

paragraphs.fr: De nombreux employés se demandent ce qu'il adviendra de leur poste.
paragraphs.en: Many employees wonder what will happen to their jobs.

paragraphs.fr: Le directeur a assuré que personne ne perdrait son emploi pendant la transition.
paragraphs.en: The director assured that no one will lose their job during the transition.

paragraphs.fr: Même s'il y aura des changements importants, l'entreprise restera engagée envers ses employés.
paragraphs.en: Although there will be important changes, the company will remain committed to its people.

paragraphs.fr: Tout le monde espère que ce changement apportera de meilleures opportunités pour l'avenir.
paragraphs.en: Everyone hopes this change will bring better opportunities for the future.

questions.question: What did the director announce?
options: A change in strategy next year

questions.question: What are employees wondering about?
options: What will happen to their jobs

questions.question: What did the director assure employees?
options: No one will lose their job during the transition

questions.question: What does everyone hope?
options: That this change brings better opportunities

lessons.title: If I Had Known
lessons.context: A reflective story using conditional and hypothetical language.

paragraphs.fr: Quand Marc était jeune, il aurait aimé étudier la musique plutôt que l'économie.
paragraphs.en: When Marc was young, he would have liked to study music instead of economics.

paragraphs.fr: À cette époque, il pensait qu'il serait plus sûr d'avoir une carrière traditionnelle.
paragraphs.en: At that time, he thought it would be safer to have a traditional career.

paragraphs.fr: Maintenant, avec plus d'expérience, il sait qu'il aurait pu combiner les deux.
paragraphs.en: Now, with more experience, he knows he could have combined both things.

paragraphs.fr: Bien qu'il ne regrette pas sa carrière, il joue toujours de la guitare le week-end.
paragraphs.en: Although he doesn't regret his career, he still plays guitar on weekends.

paragraphs.fr: Il dit à ses enfants de suivre leur passion, sans laisser la peur les arrêter.
paragraphs.en: He tells his children to follow their passion, without letting fear stop them.

questions.question: What would Marc have liked to study?
Why did he choose a traditional career instead?
options: He thought it would be safer

questions.question: What does he do on weekends?
What advice does he give his children?
options: To follow their passion without fear stopping them

lessons.title: The Museum That Was Built
lessons.titleNative: Le musée qui a été construit
lessons.context: A short informational story using passive voice.

paragraphs.fr: Ce musée a été construit il y a plus de cent ans par un architecte célèbre.
paragraphs.en: This museum was built more than a hundred years ago by a famous architect.

paragraphs.fr: Les œuvres les plus importantes ont été données par des collectionneurs privés.
paragraphs.en: The most important works were donated by private collectors.

paragraphs.fr: Chaque année, des expositions spéciales sont organisées pour attirer plus de visiteurs.
paragraphs.en: Each year, special exhibitions are organized to attract more visitors.

paragraphs.fr: Le bâtiment sera rénové l'année prochaine pour moderniser ses installations.
paragraphs.en: The building will be renovated next year to modernize its facilities.

paragraphs.fr: On espère que la rénovation sera terminée avant l'anniversaire du musée.
paragraphs.en: It is expected that the renovation will be finished before the museum's anniversary.

questions.question: Who built the museum?
Who donated the most important works?
What will happen to the building next year?
When is the renovation expected to finish?

lessons.title: What She Told Me
lessons.context: A short story built around indirect/reported speech.

paragraphs.fr: Mon amie m'a raconté qu'elle avait vécu une expérience incroyable pendant son voyage.
paragraphs.en: My friend told me she had had an incredible experience on her trip.

paragraphs.fr: Elle m'a dit qu'elle avait rencontré des gens de cultures très différentes de la sienne.
paragraphs.en: She told me she had met people from cultures very different from her own.

paragraphs.fr: Elle m'a aussi avoué qu'au début elle avait peur de voyager seule.
paragraphs.en: She also confessed to me that at first she was afraid to travel alone.

paragraphs.fr: Elle m'a assuré que cette peur avait disparu après les premiers jours.
paragraphs.en: She assured me that fear had disappeared after the first few days.

paragraphs.fr: Elle m'a promis qu'elle me raconterait tous les détails quand nous nous verrions en personne.
paragraphs.en: She promised she would tell me all the details when we saw each other in person.

questions.question: What did the friend say about her trip?
Who did she say she met?
What was she afraid of at first?
What did she promise?
options: To tell all the details in person

lessons.title: Even If It's Difficult
lessons.context: A short motivational story using the future and reported speech.

paragraphs.fr: Même si le chemin sera long, Léa est déterminée à finir son master.
paragraphs.en: Even if the road will be long, Léa is determined to finish her master's degree.

paragraphs.fr: Elle travaille le jour et étudie le soir pour que ses efforts en vaillent la peine.
paragraphs.en: She works during the day and studies at night so that her effort is worth it.

paragraphs.fr: Ses amis lui avaient dit que ce serait épuisant, et ils avaient raison.
paragraphs.en: Her friends told her it would be exhausting, and they were right.

paragraphs.fr: Pourtant, elle continue sans que personne n'ait besoin de la motiver.
paragraphs.en: However, she keeps going without anyone having to motivate her.

paragraphs.fr: On espère que tout cet effort se traduira bientôt par de nouvelles opportunités.
paragraphs.en: Hopefully all this effort will soon translate into new opportunities.

questions.question: What is Léa determined to do?
What does she do during the day and night?
options: Works during the day, studies at night

questions.question: What did her friends warn her about?
What does the writer hope?
options: That her effort translates into new opportunities

lessons.title: A Village That Will Be Remembered
lessons.titleNative: Un village dont on se souviendra
lessons.context: A short story mixing future, passive voice, and community themes.

paragraphs.fr: Ce petit village sera connu pour la façon dont il a fait face à la crise.
paragraphs.en: The small town will be remembered for the way it faced the crisis.

paragraphs.fr: Quand l'inondation est arrivée, les maisons ont été évacuées rapidement.
paragraphs.en: When the flood arrived, the houses were quickly evacuated.

paragraphs.fr: Les voisins se sont organisés pour que personne ne reste sans aide.
paragraphs.en: The neighbors organized so that no one was left without help.

paragraphs.fr: Le pont qui a été détruit sera reconstruit avec des fonds du gouvernement.
paragraphs.en: The bridge that was destroyed will be rebuilt with government funds.

paragraphs.fr: Même s'ils ont perdu beaucoup, la communauté a montré une force incroyable.
paragraphs.en: Although they lost a lot, the community showed incredible strength.

questions.question: What will the town be remembered for?
What happened to the houses during the flood?
What will happen to the destroyed bridge?
options: It will be rebuilt with government funds
It will be replaced by a new road

questions.question: What did the community demonstrate?

lessons.title: The Interview I'll Never Forget
lessons.context: A story combining future, conditional, and reported speech naturally.

paragraphs.fr: Avant l'entretien, je pensais que ce serait un désastre total.
paragraphs.en: Before the interview, I thought it would be a total disaster.

paragraphs.fr: On m'avait dit d'arriver tôt et d'apporter tous mes documents.
paragraphs.en: They told me to arrive early and bring all my documents.

paragraphs.fr: Même si j'étais très nerveux, j'ai répondu à chaque question avec confiance.
paragraphs.en: Even though I was very nervous, I answered every question with confidence.

paragraphs.fr: À la fin, on m'a dit qu'on m'appellerait si j'étais sélectionné.
paragraphs.en: In the end, they told me they would call me in case I was selected.

paragraphs.fr: Deux jours plus tard, j'ai reçu l'appel qui allait changer ma vie pour toujours.
paragraphs.en: Two days later, I received the call that would change my life forever.

questions.question: What did the writer think before the interview?
options: It would be a total disaster

questions.question: What were they told to do?
How did they answer despite being nervous?
What happened two days later?

lessons.title: A Promise Kept
lessons.context: A story about a promise made and fulfilled, using indirect speech.

paragraphs.fr: Il y a dix ans, j'avais promis à ma grand-mère que je finirais mes études.
paragraphs.en: Ten years ago, I promised my grandmother I would finish my studies.

paragraphs.fr: Elle m'avait dit qu'elle serait fière, peu importe le temps que cela prendrait.
paragraphs.en: She told me she would be proud no matter how long it took.

paragraphs.fr: Il y a eu des moments où je pensais que je n'y arriverais jamais.
paragraphs.en: There were moments when I thought I would never achieve it.

paragraphs.fr: Pourtant, j'ai continué pour que cette promesse soit tenue.
paragraphs.en: However, I kept going so that promise would be fulfilled.

paragraphs.fr: Le jour de ma remise de diplôme, j'ai senti que j'avais enfin tenu parole.
paragraphs.en: On my graduation day, I felt I had finally kept my word.

questions.question: What did the writer promise their grandmother?
What did the grandmother say?
options: She would be proud no matter how long it took

questions.question: What did the writer sometimes think?
options: That they would never achieve it

questions.question: How did the writer feel on graduation day?
options: That they had finally kept their word

lessons.title: The Decision That Will Define Us
lessons.context: A reflective story about a pivotal choice, using future and passive voice.

paragraphs.fr: Le comité se réunira demain pour décider de l'avenir du projet.
paragraphs.en: The committee will meet tomorrow so they can decide the project's future.

paragraphs.fr: Même si les avis sont partagés, tout le monde s'accorde à dire qu'un changement est nécessaire.
paragraphs.en: Although opinions are divided, everyone agrees that change is needed.

paragraphs.fr: On s'attend à ce que la décision soit annoncée avant la fin de la semaine.
paragraphs.en: The decision is expected to be announced before the week ends.

paragraphs.fr: Quel que soit le résultat, nous savons que ce ne sera pas une décision facile.
paragraphs.en: Whatever the outcome, we know it won't be an easy decision.

paragraphs.fr: On espère qu'ils choisiront la voie qui profitera à tout le monde de manière égale.
paragraphs.en: Hopefully they choose the path that benefits everyone equally.

questions.question: When will the committee meet?
What do people agree on?
When is the decision expected to be announced?
What does the writer hope?
options: That the decision favors a few people
That the decision benefits everyone equally

lessons.title: Looking Ahead
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing B1+'s key grammar in context.

paragraphs.fr: Quand je regarde vers l'avenir, je sais qu'il y aura des défis que je ne peux pas prévoir.
paragraphs.en: When I look toward the future, I know there will be challenges I can't predict.

paragraphs.fr: Même si tout ne se passera pas exactement comme je l'avais prévu, je fais confiance à ma capacité à m'adapter.
paragraphs.en: Although not everything will turn out exactly as I've planned, I trust my ability to adapt.

paragraphs.fr: J'aimerais que cette nouvelle année soit encore meilleure que la précédente.
paragraphs.en: I would like this coming year to be even better than the last.

paragraphs.fr: J'espère que tout ce que j'ai appris m'aidera à prendre de meilleures décisions.
paragraphs.en: I hope everything I've learned helps me make better decisions.

paragraphs.fr: Quoi que réserve l'avenir, je serai prêt à l'affronter.
paragraphs.en: Whatever the future brings, I'll be ready to face it.

questions.question: What does the writer know about the future?
What does the writer trust?
What does the writer hope for next year?
options: That it be even better than the last

questions.question: How does the writer feel about facing the future?
